author: BimboMarie
body:
Tel, 
why have you banned me? I got NONE kills this morning and I have been banned for kill aura after being ACCIDENTLY mistaken for a hacker the other day by sweetmango in which he apologised for his mistake? So why do you think I did the same thing again which I never did in the first place, and this morning I didn't kill anyone? I was only for about 10 minutes therefore, where is your proof of me killing someone using kill aura... This is not logical and I want something done about it. I've never been banned in my life before and have never hacked. 

Please dont lock this, and tel I hope you see this.
